messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-98321 triggered: sustained high 5xx rate on /v1/generate (aggregation=120s) — 5xx_rate=6.3% (>5% threshold). Region: us-west1. Affected service: inference-gateway. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98321 , https://grafana/redwood/d/infer/latency?orgId=1

maya: acked and assigned to oncall (maya). Taking triage. :hand: First glance — customers reporting increased 500s for generation requests.

mike: on it. pulling recent tail logs for the gateway and model hosts. quick check: `curl -s -D - https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'` shows 502s consistently from nw-proxy.

jordan: I'm seeing repeated OOM kill traces on model-host-3 in the logs: `OOM killer invoked: oom_score_adj` and container restart loops ~every 20s. Not sure why mem suddenly spikes.

maya: status: throttling rules kicked in, but customers still see errors. Is this localized to a host or a region?

mike: metric slice: 98% of 5xx originate from us-west1 AZ-b and correlate with model-host-3 and proxy-b. I can drain model-host-3 from LB now if we want to reduce customer impact.

jordan: +1 drain. also checking kernel / dmesg for cgroup OOM vs process OOM. running `kubectl describe pod model-host-3` and `kubectl logs model-host-3 --previous --tail=200`.

lee: pinging support/CS — alex-cs, can you surface which customers were hit and whether legacy batching endpoints are affected?

alex-cs: saw 23 unique customers with elevated 5xx in last 3m, most are PLG apps — top two with high volume: humatech, notesly. Customers show spike in short requests (len < 64). I'm drafting an outbound note if we need one.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) drain model-host-3, 2) shift 20% traffic from us-west1 to us-east1 fallback pool, 3) enable temporary rate-limiting on non-SLA customers. Anyone object?

mike: executing drain now: `kubectl cordon model-host-3 && kubectl drain model-host-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` — starting. Will monitor error rate.

jordan: I'm provisioning additional swapless memory limits might be causing OOM due to new quantized runtime. Looking at recent deploys — there was a small infra rollout 6m ago that changed container memory requests on model-hosts. Could be correlated.

mike: traffic shifted +20% to us-east1 fallback. 5xx rate dropping to ~3.1% in the sliced view for /v1/generate in us-west1 overall, but model-host-3 still flapping (restarts continuing).

alex-cs: customers humatech and notesly seeing fewer errors now per telemetry. Humatech asks for ETA.

lee: ETA estimate: initial mitigation in 10-15m. We'll follow up with a customer note once stabilized.

maya: assigning follow-ups: eng-mike and sre-jordan to investigate root cause of OOM and recent infra rollout; lee + alex-cs to draft customer update; maya to keep oncall until stable.

mike: evidence: `kubectl get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | grep model-host-3` shows evictions at 03:12:11 and 03:12:31 right after a kubelet memory pressure event. Uploading logs to /tmp/PD-98321/model-host-3.tgz.

jordan: repro hypothesis: a change in model runtime memory accounting after the last quantized model push increased RSS due to an unbounded cache growth. I'll add an OOM guard and a memory cap as a quick rollback.

maya: status update 03:28 UTC: traffic reroute + drain complete, error rate fallen to 1.4% cluster-wide. Keeping page open for 30m post-recovery.

alex-cs: customer note draft: "We experienced an elevated error rate for text-generation requests affecting a subset of customers in US-West. We mitigated by draining an unhealthy host and shifting traffic to a fallback pool; full recovery in progress. Contact support for details."

lee: thanks. once Jordan has root cause confirmation, we'll open a postmortem and link runbook. Runbook ref: https://go/redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx-triage

mike: follow-up actions logged in PD incident: restart rollback on recent infra patch, add canary memory pressure alarms, add guardrails to quantized runtime cache.

jordan: copying logs and heap snapshots to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/PD-98321/heapshots/ ; will attach to incident.

maya: leaving oncall handoff note for night team: monitor 5xx_rate and host restart loops; if errors >3% for 10m, escalate to eng-lead. cc @lee.

incident-bot: Incident PD-98321 acknowledged by maya. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maya: closing thread for now, will reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:
